mapper.insert: INSERT INTO presale_ai_prompt_result ( version_id, batch_no, platform_code, prompt_template_id, competitor_name, query_call_id, analyze_call_id, effective_sample, request_prompt_content, is_mentioned, ranking, sentiment, mentioned_competitors, scene_advantages, top_keywords_json, negative_evidence_json ) SELECT #{row.versionId}, #{row.batchNo}, #{row.platformCode}, #{row.promptTemplateId}, #{row.competitorName}, #{row.queryCallId}, #{row.analyzeCallId}, #{row.effectiveSample}, #{row.requestPromptContent}, #{row.isMentioned}, #{row.ranking}, #{row.sentiment}, #{row.mentionedCompetitors}, #{row.sceneAdvantages}, #{row.topKeywordsJson}, #{row.negativeEvidenceJson} FROM presale_report_version v WHERE v.id = #{row.versionId} AND v.generation_status = 'RUNNING' AND v.generation_attempt = #{generationAttempt} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), query_call_id = VALUES(query_call_id), analyze_call_id = VALUES(analyze_call_id), effective_sample = VALUES(effective_sample), request_prompt_content = VALUES(request_prompt_content), is_mentioned = VALUES(is_mentioned), ranking = VALUES(ranking), sentiment = VALUES(sentiment), mentioned_competitors = VALUES(mentioned_competitors), scene_advantages = VALUES(scene_advantages), top_keywords_json = VALUES(top_keywords_json), negative_evidence_json = VALUES(negative_evidence_json), created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
